definitions.name: ScheduleRefusal
definitions.reasoning: Only allowlisted scheduler/upstream codes are retained; no caller data or exception text escapes.

definitions.name: ScheduleRefusal.__init__
definitions.reasoning: Normalize fixed code/cause fields; inherited string contains only the fixed scheduler code.

definitions.name: _need
definitions.reasoning: One fail-closed branch; no automatic repair or fallback.

definitions.name: _hash
definitions.reasoning: Reject bool/non-string, wrong length/case, and zero trust pins.

definitions.name: _sha
definitions.reasoning: SHA256 over exact bytes; hashing is integrity/provenance, not authentication by itself.

definitions.name: _integer
definitions.reasoning: Require actual JSON integer in bounded inclusive range; bool/float/string refused.

definitions.name: _absolute
definitions.reasoning: Require explicit absolute local paths; no parent traversal, NUL, network-root spelling or linked path resolution.

definitions.name: _separate
definitions.reasoning: Reject equal/nested mutable outputs and protected input/runtime/signer references.

definitions.name: _remaining
definitions.reasoning: Pass only integral remaining seconds under one original wrapper deadline; floor cannot replenish the budget.

definitions.name: _private_directory
definitions.reasoning: Require direct real directory owned by invoking UID with0700 and protected parent; trusted ancestors/same UID remain host boundary.

definitions.name: _private_inventory
definitions.reasoning: Exactly supported private single-link regular entries; unexpected temporary residue refuses without deletion or promotion.

definitions.name: _load
definitions.reasoning: Exact externally supplied policy SHA and strict schema, bounded settings, original raw config pin and exact19-source map before writes. Runtime refs inspected as metadata; missing/malformed journal/health bytes are not consumed. Rebind shares the NEW global budget.

definitions.name: _stable
definitions.reasoning: Recheck original raw policy/config plus all source identities; no edited hash acceptance, source adoption or journal relabeling.

definitions.name: _selection
definitions.reasoning: Require committed selection and lock, exact schema/deployment/config/policy identity, bounded generation basename and pin; no discovery/fallback.

definitions.name: _observer_state
definitions.reasoning: Observe refuses missing/corrupt/unexpected state, preserving outbox/clock; backup does not depend on this state.

definitions.name: _generation_count
definitions.reasoning: Backup-only bounded directory enumeration counts partial attempts, never selects a newest folder or prunes retained data.

definitions.name: _publish
definitions.reasoning: Pre-bound encoded selection64KiB, hold shared lock, recheck new/previous policies immediately before atomic publication. Post-rename fsync errors remain uncertain and require review; no rollback guessing.

definitions.name: _backup
definitions.reasoning: Create exclusive random generation, use original backup+verify guards with remaining budget, then publish selection. Capture/verify failures preserve prior selection; complete/unapproved attempts remain counted.

definitions.name: _observe
definitions.reasoning: Use only explicit selected path+pin and original config through existing observer. Backup capture failure/capacity does not block observing selected backup. Fixed upstream refusal codes retained.

definitions.name: run_once
definitions.reasoning: Explicit init only creates directories/state; partial init requires manual review. One persistent lock serializes wrappers. Independent backup/observe state gates, operational-only rebind preserves all selected fields except policy SHA and never reads/resets alert state. Final source/policy check after observation can refuse without undoing a committed outbox.

definitions.name: SafeArgumentParser
definitions.reasoning: CLI argument failures exclude arbitrary argument/error values.

definitions.name: SafeArgumentParser.error
definitions.reasoning: Fixed usage/error message only; no input interpolation.

definitions.name: main
definitions.reasoning: One explicit action; previous-policy flags only for rebind. Only bounded sanitized scheduler result/refusal JSON, no process/RPC/signer/service operation.

limitations: Source-file hashes are not loaded-code attestation; host administrators/UID and protected ancestors remain trusted.
Automatic local manifest handoff is not independent or off-host authentication.
Cooperative deadlines cannot preempt kernel I/O or fsync stalls; separately reviewed systemd hard supervision is required.
Initial multi-directory publication is not transactional; incomplete init and unexpected temporary residue require preserved manual review.
Atomic rename followed by failed directory fsync may leave old or new selection; never blindly rollback or relaunch init.
Scheduler/source/config pin refusal is supervisor-visible and cannot itself queue an observer HTTP incident.
Rebind changes only operational policy with exact source/config/path identity; no release/journal/host migration is implemented.
Backup preserves exact journal bytes; it does not back up separate original configuration, signer material or observer state.
Capacity is bounded retained generations, including partial attempts; no automatic deletion or optimal retention policy.
Observe reports retained_generations null because unrelated backup inventory is deliberately not scanned.
scope: New unsigned scheduler core and CLI only; static source reasoning before parent-approved execution.
